scope: Selected manufacturer-documented models; supplements upstream inventories, not exhaustive

models.name: SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless
models.software: GG Engine / base station; PC software for surround
caveats: Base-station/hardware settings and PC software processing are separate paths.
Public UI documentation does not establish a native host setter for every option.
Do not transfer Nova Pro Omni or wired GameDAC-specific protocol assumptions.

models.name: Logitech G PRO X SUPERLIGHT (first generation)

controls.dpi: manufacturer resolution range 100–25600; protocol must enumerate actual values

caveats: Do not transfer Superlight 2/HERO 2 specifications to this model.
This source does not document user RGB lighting; do not invent it.

models.name: Logitech G502 HERO
caveats: Product page contains inconsistent minimum DPI (200 in overview, 100 in sensor details); do not hardcode minimum from marketing text.
Physical weights and scroll-wheel mechanical behavior are not software controls.

models.name: Razer DeathAdder V2
models.software: Synapse (original documentation: Synapse 3; check Synapse 4 exact support)
caveats: OpenRazer's methods for this model do not expose every feature advertised by Synapse; separate the two evidence sets.

models.name: Razer DeathAdder V2 Pro
caveats: Different transports must not share an assumed packet route or feature set.

models.name: SteelSeries Apex Pro Gen 3 / TKL Gen 3
caveats: Not all keys use OmniPoint: numpad/arrows/function/navigation include regular Red switches. Do not offer actuation on all keys.

models.name: HyperX Pulsefire Haste 2 (wired)
models.software: NGENUITY; verify current versus Legacy version

controls.polling_rate: up to 8000 Hz; default 1000; keyboard shortcut or NGENUITY

caveats: Do not copy wired 8000 Hz spec to Haste 2 Wireless or Mini.
Public product feature is not a published native DPI protocol.

models.name: MSI CLUTCH GM51 LIGHTWEIGHT (wired)
models.software: MSI Center / Gaming Gear; Mystic Light for lighting
caveats: Polling maximum is a hardware specification; exact selectable rate list not established here.

models.name: MSI CLUTCH GM51 LIGHTWEIGHT WIRELESS
caveats: Wireless model maximum is 1000 Hz in cited sheet; wired sibling advertises 8000 Hz.

models.name: Cooler Master MM712 Sakura Limited Edition

controls.lighting: RGB present; exact mode controls not established in this source

caveats: Spec explicitly refers to Sakura SKU MM-712-WWOH2.
Angle snapping presence does not by itself document a software toggle.
Firmware workflow described by vendor is outside UniDevice configuration scope.

models.name: Glorious Model O 2 Wired
caveats: Do not copy first-generation Model O wired software/protocol or Model O 2 PRO advanced debounce settings.

models.name: Turtle Beach Burst II Air

controls.onboard_memory: present; exact saved field subset not specified

caveats: No arbitrary RGB control inferred from indicator LEDs.
Swarm II family features do not prove every model exposes all settings.

models.name: Wooting 60HE+
caveats: RGB SDK is lighting, Analog SDK is analog-input reading; neither establishes a public setter for every Wootility option.
Analog keyboard cannot be emulated by adding software actuation sliders to mechanical hardware.

models.name: Keychron Q1 HE 8K

controls.lighting: per-key RGB and Mix RGB guides

caveats: Do not confuse Q1 HE 8K with earlier Q1 HE wireless or Q1 mechanical.
HE guide says settings save automatically; persistence must be classified before implementing writers.

models.name: Gembird MUSGW-6BL-01 Firebolt
models.software: No host configuration API established in reviewed product page
caveats: Hardware-adjustable does not imply host-writable.
User's unidentified Gembird keyboard cannot be matched to this product or any keyboard SKU.
